children: Malaysia tech companies' 3Q results season is expected to resemble the previous quarter's, with strong fundamentals and robust demand supporting earnings, Hong Leong Investment Bank analyst Toh Woo Kim says in a note. Demand is supported by AI investment, China+1 diversification, supply-chain localization and new customer wins, he says. However, higher bond yields, elevated oil prices and a hawkish U.S. Fed outlook could keep markets volatile, as seen last quarter when technology stocks fell despite strong results from major technology and semiconductor companies, he reckons. Toh recommends using market pullbacks to accumulate quality stocks with solid earnings visibility and potential for upward earnings revisions. Hong Leong maintains an overweight rating on the Malaysian tech sector, pegging Vitrox, UWC, SAM Engineering & Equipment (M) and Itmax System as its top picks. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
